digest.component_or_area: ticket clarity validation and deterministic rule refinement
propositions: Proposed deterministic clarity floor must be validated against closed tickets carrying both plan-review and completion-verifier attestations to eliminate false positives.
Hard floor rules must fail only when ticket state is structurally incompatible with executable planning; rules with legitimate historical matches must be narrowed or removed.

Bare unresolved sentinels fire as hard-floor violations only when they occupy value positions (start lines, follow colons/equals/is-predicates) in exact active execution sections, with removal assertions suppressed.

Nonempty parsed Acceptance Criteria checkbox items and unresolved sentinel assignments in active sections are the only two net-new hard clarity additions; all other rules move to advisory or subsystem-specific validation.
Historical counterexamples like ticket 8d27 (duplicate global gate) and 6673/94f9 (valid provenance citations) must pass validation to confirm rules avoid false positives.
